--- ## Overview **AZenith** is an All-In-One (AIO) Universal Performance module for Android — built to work across devices and ROMs, and designed to respect your preferences: nothing is forced, every tweak is opt-in and stays fully under your control. It pairs two Rust daemons with a Material 3 Expressive manager app: **archdaemon** (profiles, bypass charging, FPS Recorder) and **sysdaemon** (pure-binder app monitor + FPS client). Together they auto-switch performance profiles when a game runs, tune kernel scheduling, record real frametime stats, and put an in-game Game Space overlay on screen — without shell-forking in the hot path. --- ## Features ### Game Space A landscape, gamepad-first shell built on Material 3 Expressive — smooth, playful UI with spring animations, dynamic colors and notification-style cards. Launched from the manager, then handed over to the overlay service for the rest of the session. Designed for gamepad users: D-Pad / joystick navigation, A select, B back, L1/R1 switch tab, no touch required. - **Perfect dashboard in one place** — game library tiles, app tiles, spotlight, BGM playlist with now-playing controls, wallpapers, status trophies, battery, service PID, games tracked, FPS, CPU/GPU load and temps all on one landscape screen - **Ambient music** — customizable BGM playlist (shuffle / repeat / sequential) with volume control and long-press quick actions - **Fun interface** — expressive shapes, dynamic Material You theming, spring micro-animations, boot hand-off sequence (linking, scan, tune, ready), quick toggles for profile, refresh rate and tweaks - Settings: appearance (sidepanel side / sensitivity / length / thickness / opacity / blur, custom images), audio, general (boost on launch, renderer, refresh rate, frame-rate target, resolution downscale), tweaks (FPSGO, GED, WAL, SFL, thermal, scheduler), and About - Floating app windows on top of the game (open from inside the shell) - Crosshair reticle overlay ### Sidepanel + FPS Monitor Edge-bar + expandable Material 3 Expressive dock — every control you need lives right inside the game: profile switch, battery, temps and framerate without ever leaving the session. - Handle bar (swipe-in to expand, vertical drag to reposition, configurable length/thickness/side) — shown only for games in your configured list, app-lunch list, or when force-sidepanel is on - **In-game access control** — switch profile, check battery and temps, and watch framerate live, all from the dock - **FPS Meter** with small `FPS` badge flush left of the number, frame time (`1000 / fps` ms) and estimated 1% Low - **FPS Recorder** — one-tap Start / Stop (record pill with ripple, session timer); writes CSV + JSON summaries with real `ft_avg` / `ft_max` / `low1` / `low01` / `jank` from the frametime histogram - **Customizable layout** — widgets (FPS, CPU, GPU, temp, ping, battery, profile) with HUD offsets, global + per-app layouts - **Floating apps** — open other apps in floating windows on top of the game from inside the dock - Quick Apps row, brightness/volume sliders, auto-mode toggle, profile switcher, toasts ### Per-App Tuning Per-app tweaks override every global setting for the selected game — set each parameter once per game and it applies on game focus, falling back to the global values otherwise: - Per-app Lite Mode (cap at ~90% CPU freq, mid-frequency ladder) - Per-app rendering (renderer override: default / SkiaVulkan / SkiaGLES / software) - Per-app refresh rate (target from the device's mode list) - Per-app downscaler (resolution downscale 0–100% + target FPS slider) - Per-app DND (do-not-disturb during gaming) - App Priority (process priority boost) - Game Preload (libs + page-cache preload, with budget) - Resolution downscale badge always shows the live divider _(Display config is not per-app — there is no per-app display filter.)_ ### Profiles AZenith switches profile automatically depending on what you need — gaming in foreground → Performance, battery saver on → ECO, everything else → Balanced (with a 10 s screen-off grace and 30 s foreground-away grace before dropping back). You can also take manual control: turn off **Auto Mode** in Settings and pick **Performance**, **Balanced** or **ECO** yourself whenever you want. ### Custom Governor AZenith lets you set a custom CPU governor **per profile** — pick your own governor for Performance, Balanced and ECO instead of the stock defaults: - Custom CPU governor per profile (`custom_*_cpu_gov`) - Custom I/O scheduler per profile (`custom_*_IO`) - Custom Mali GPU governor per profile (`custom_*_maligpu_gov`) - Stock defaults stay untouched unless you override them; `balanced` can also restore the saved baseline governor - `disabletweak` master switch ### Thermalcore Intelligent thermal throttling — watches CPU/GPU temps and adapts limits so you hold a stable FPS floor instead of thermal-crashing. ### Bypass Charging Built-in bypass charging for supported devices: - Diagnostic check that tests whether your device actually supports the feature before enabling it - Adjustable charging threshold to match your battery health usage - Charging-state dynamic bypass while gaming ### Preference Tweaks AZenith ships extra add-on tweaks you can enable or disable whenever you like — flip each one on/off from the tweaks screen and it applies immediately: - schedtunes, WALT tunes - FPSGO & GED parameters (MediaTek), Mali scheduler - SFL latency, display colour presets --- ## Installation Magisk module — install through your root manager (KernelSU / Magisk): 1. Flash the release zip. 2. Reboot. 3. Enjoy --- ## For Developers (ROM Integration) **ROM-Integrated AZenith**: system-level service for custom ROMs — single `vendor.azenith-service` binary, AIDL interface, init rc, sepolicy. See the [RomIntegratedAZenith](https://github.com/Liliya2727/RomIntegratedAZenith) repository. --- ## Contributing & Bug Reports We welcome contributions! - **Report Bugs:** open an issue with a log. - **Feature Requests:** open an issue to discuss. - **Pull Requests:** fork, create a branch, submit a PR with a clear description. --- ## Credits & Acknowledgements | Role | Developer | | :--- | :--- | | **Author** | [@Zexshia](https://github.com/Liliya2727) | | **Collaborators** | [@rianixia](https://github.com/ryanistr), [@kanaochar](https://github.com/kanaodnd) | | Area | Credits | | :--- | :--- | | App Translation & Internationalization | @YIDYIF | | Tweak Sources | @Rem01Gaming, @MiAzami, @KanagawaYamadaVTeacher, @ShiraXblood, @Laynsb, @Koneko_dev | | Game Preload | @HoyoSlave, @KutuMoba, @Feravolt, @iamlooper | --- ## Stay Updated

---

Overview

AZenith is an All-In-One (AIO) Universal Performance module for

Android — built to work across devices and ROMs, and designed to

respect your preferences: nothing is forced, every tweak is opt-in and

stays fully under your control.

It pairs two Rust daemons with a Material 3 Expressive manager app:

archdaemon (profiles, bypass charging, FPS Recorder) and

sysdaemon (pure-binder app monitor + FPS client). Together they

auto-switch performance profiles when a game runs, tune kernel

scheduling, record real frametime stats, and put an in-game Game Space

overlay on screen — without shell-forking in the hot path.

---

Features

Game Space

A landscape, gamepad-first shell built on Material 3 Expressive —

smooth, playful UI with spring animations, dynamic colors and

notification-style cards. Launched from the manager, then handed over

to the overlay service for the rest of the session. Designed for

gamepad users: D-Pad / joystick navigation, A select, B back, L1/R1

switch tab, no touch required.

  • **Perfect dashboard in one place** — game library tiles, app tiles,

    • spotlight, BGM playlist with now-playing controls, wallpapers,

    status trophies, battery, service PID, games tracked, FPS, CPU/GPU

    load and temps all on one landscape screen

  • **Ambient music** — customizable BGM playlist (shuffle / repeat /

    • sequential) with volume control and long-press quick actions

  • **Fun interface** — expressive shapes, dynamic Material You

    • theming, spring micro-animations, boot hand-off sequence

    (linking, scan, tune, ready), quick toggles for profile,

    refresh rate and tweaks

  • Settings: appearance (sidepanel side / sensitivity / length /

    • thickness / opacity / blur, custom images), audio, general (boost

    on launch, renderer, refresh rate, frame-rate target, resolution

    downscale), tweaks (FPSGO, GED, WAL, SFL, thermal, scheduler),

    and About

  • Floating app windows on top of the game (open from inside the shell)
  • Crosshair reticle overlay

    • Sidepanel + FPS Monitor

    Edge-bar + expandable Material 3 Expressive dock — every control

    you need lives right inside the game: profile switch, battery, temps

    and framerate without ever leaving the session.

  • Handle bar (swipe-in to expand, vertical drag to reposition,

    • configurable length/thickness/side) — shown only for games in your

    configured list, app-lunch list, or when force-sidepanel is on

  • **In-game access control** — switch profile, check battery and

    • temps, and watch framerate live, all from the dock

  • **FPS Meter** with small `FPS` badge flush left of the number,

    • frame time (1000 / fps ms) and estimated 1% Low

  • **FPS Recorder** — one-tap Start / Stop (record pill with ripple,

    • session timer); writes CSV + JSON summaries with real ft_avg /

    ft_max / low1 / low01 / jank from the frametime histogram

  • **Customizable layout** — widgets (FPS, CPU, GPU, temp, ping,

    • battery, profile) with HUD offsets, global + per-app layouts

  • **Floating apps** — open other apps in floating windows on top of

    • the game from inside the dock

  • Quick Apps row, brightness/volume sliders, auto-mode toggle,

    • profile switcher, toasts

    Per-App Tuning

    Per-app tweaks override every global setting for the selected game —

    set each parameter once per game and it applies on game focus,

    falling back to the global values otherwise:

  • Per-app Lite Mode (cap at ~90% CPU freq, mid-frequency ladder)
  • Per-app rendering (renderer override: default / SkiaVulkan /

    • SkiaGLES / software)

  • Per-app refresh rate (target from the device's mode list)
  • Per-app downscaler (resolution downscale 0–100% + target FPS slider)
  • Per-app DND (do-not-disturb during gaming)
  • App Priority (process priority boost)
  • Game Preload (libs + page-cache preload, with budget)
  • Resolution downscale badge always shows the live divider

    • _(Display config is not per-app — there is no per-app display filter.)_

    Profiles

    AZenith switches profile automatically depending on what you need —

    gaming in foreground → Performance, battery saver on → ECO,

    everything else → Balanced (with a 10 s screen-off grace and 30 s

    foreground-away grace before dropping back).

    You can also take manual control: turn off Auto Mode in Settings

    and pick Performance, Balanced or ECO yourself whenever

    you want.

    Custom Governor

    AZenith lets you set a custom CPU governor per profile — pick

    your own governor for Performance, Balanced and ECO instead of the

    stock defaults:

  • Custom CPU governor per profile (`custom_*_cpu_gov`)
  • Custom I/O scheduler per profile (`custom_*_IO`)
  • Custom Mali GPU governor per profile (`custom_*_maligpu_gov`)
  • Stock defaults stay untouched unless you override them; `balanced`

    • can also restore the saved baseline governor

  • `disabletweak` master switch

    • Thermalcore

    Intelligent thermal throttling — watches CPU/GPU temps and adapts

    limits so you hold a stable FPS floor instead of thermal-crashing.

    Bypass Charging

    Built-in bypass charging for supported devices:

  • Diagnostic check that tests whether your device actually supports

    • the feature before enabling it

  • Adjustable charging threshold to match your battery health usage
  • Charging-state dynamic bypass while gaming

    • Preference Tweaks

    AZenith ships extra add-on tweaks you can enable or disable whenever

    you like — flip each one on/off from the tweaks screen and it applies

    immediately:

  • schedtunes, WALT tunes
  • FPSGO & GED parameters (MediaTek), Mali scheduler
  • SFL latency, display colour presets

    • ---

    Installation

    Magisk module — install through your root manager (KernelSU /

    Magisk):

  • Flash the release zip.
  • Reboot.
  • Enjoy

    • ---

    For Developers (ROM Integration)

    ROM-Integrated AZenith: system-level service for custom ROMs —

    single vendor.azenith-service binary, AIDL interface, init rc,

    sepolicy. See the

    RomIntegratedAZenith

    repository.

    ---

    Contributing & Bug Reports

    We welcome contributions!

  • **Report Bugs:** open an issue with a log.
  • **Feature Requests:** open an issue to discuss.
  • **Pull Requests:** fork, create a branch, submit a PR with a clear

    • description.
